# C02 design: Independent scout registration and conflicts

Covers AUTH08, AUTH09, AUTH10, ADMIN01 (scouts) and ADMIN06 (suspension only), plus NFR23, NFR24 and NFR27 for every new screen.

Surfaces:

1. Public scout registration: `/register` (5 steps; 4 for a signed-in user)
2. Terms acceptance: step 4 of `/register`, reused as the terms section on `/scout`
3. The scout's own profile: `/scout`
4. Admin scout-approval list: `/admin/scouts`
5. `AdminNav` sub-navigation on both admin pages
6. The Scout profile nav item and the `SCOUT_STATES` chip preset
7. Scout emails (draft copy)

## Rules for the whole chunk

- **D01, C01 and D02 rules still apply.** Use tokens only, through `var(--token)` or the token-mapped Tailwind utilities. Use spacing steps 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 and 12 only. Set text with the type classes only (`heading-1`, `heading-2`, `body-lg`, `body`, `body-strong`, `label`, `caption`, `data`, `eyebrow`). Lucide icons go through `iconProps`, are `aria-hidden`, and always sit next to a word. The focus ring is the global `:focus-visible` rule.
- **Theme.** No C02 surface is forced dark. Every page follows the system setting, including `/admin/scouts`. Only the review workspace (C11) and the Lab are forced dark.
- **One primary button per view.** Each registration step counts as one view, and so does a dialog. Admin row actions are always `secondary`, `ghost` or `danger` at `sm` size.
- **Server action results, field errors, banners, pending labels, ConfirmDialog, phone card lists and touch sizes:** exactly as in C01 ("Rules for the whole chunk"). Reuse `useFormAction`, `Field`, `SubmitButton`, `FormBusy`, `useFocusFirstInvalid`, `Banner`, `SuccessBanner`, `FormErrorBanner` (`components/forms.tsx`), `useSectionAction` and `useSectionResult` (`components/section-result.ts`) and `ConfirmDialog`.
- **Dates.** `formatDate()` from `lib/labels.ts`. Dates in table cells use `data`.
- **Phone numbers** are shown as stored (E.164, for example `+27821234567`) in `data`.
- **Never show an ID or passport number,** not even masked. Nothing holds it after submit. Show the document type and country only.
- **Chips are for states only.** The scout status is a chip. Email confirmation, conflict match state and terms state are an icon plus words in `caption`, never a chip.
- **Labels.** Scout statuses: Awaiting approval, Approved, Suspended, Not approved. Documents: South African ID, Passport. Affiliation types: Club, Player. Organisation type `scout_network`: Scout network. The scout network organisation's name is "Wideline scouts".
- **Copy.** Sentence case, no exclamation marks, no emoji, British and South African spelling. Say *match* and *club*, never *game* or *team owner*.
- **Draft copy.** The terms text and every email body are draft. Mark them in code with `// Draft copy: legal review (Q-004)` for the terms and `// Draft copy` for emails.

### Deviation from the plan, on purpose

- **Pending chip label is "Awaiting approval", not "Waiting for approval".** The StatusChip README allows at most two words, and "Awaiting" matches the match state "Awaiting review". The e2e asserts "Awaiting approval".
- **Rejected chip tone is `danger`, not `neutral`.** The README and the colour rules use `danger` for rejected. The label stays "Not approved", which reads less harshly to the scout.
- **`/scout` uses `PageHeader` plus sections, not `DetailPage`.** DetailPage's hero sets the title in `display-xl`, which the design system keeps for player names.
- **Signed-in registration also switches the active organisation** to the scout network (`SCOUT_NETWORK_ORG_ID`) before redirecting to `/scout`. Without that, a coach who registers would land on `/scout` in their club, where they have no scout role, and see "No access".
- **No password at registration (security review, after build).** A signed-out form proves nothing about the email, and an account whose password was chosen by whoever typed the address could later receive a club invitation (account pre-hijacking). So registration has 4 steps, never 5: it creates the User (unverified) and the ScoutProfile with no password and no session, and sends the confirmation link. The link signs the mailbox owner in on `/scout`, where a **Set a password** section stays until they set one. Better Auth also requires a verified email for password sign-in, revokes any account link or session an unverified user had when the email is first confirmed, and `acceptInvitation` refuses a signed-in user whose email is not verified.
- **Declared conflicts block without an admin (requirements review, after build).** An unlinked affiliation whose name (club, or a player's club) equals an active academy, club or agency name, case-insensitively, counts in `scoutConflicts`. Approval links each unchecked row with exactly one such match (audited, `automatic: true`). Saving **Not matched** now marks the row checked (`linkedAt`, `linkedById`) instead of clearing it, and `/admin/scouts` shows how many scouts in the tab have unchecked rows, with a filter (`?unchecked=1`), so clubs added after approval get seen.
- **`/login` must let a signed-in user without an organisation continue to `/register`.** Today it sends them to `/organisations` unless `next` starts with `/invite/`. Add `/register` to that exception.

### CSS: append to the "Additions (not in bundle.css)" block in `web/src/styles/components.css`

None of these is in the design system. Each is specified from existing tokens. Start with `/* Scout registration and profile for C02 (docs/build/design/C02.md). Not in the design system; built from tokens. */`

| Rule | Spec |
|---|---|
| `.wl-choice input[type="checkbox"]` | Same as the radio rule: `accent-color: var(--pitch); width: 20px; height: 20px; margin: 0; flex: none`. |
| `.wl-choice--top` | For labels that wrap onto several lines: `align-items: flex-start`. The input gets `margin-top: 1px`, so it lines up with the first line of `body`. |
| `.wl-steps` | The step progress bar, shown only with JavaScript. `display: grid; grid-auto-flow: column; grid-auto-columns: 1fr; gap: var(--space-1)`. `aria-hidden="true"`; the "Step n of 5" text carries the meaning. |
| `.wl-steps__seg` | `height: var(--space-1); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--line-strong)`. |
| `.wl-steps__seg[data-done="true"]`, `.wl-steps__seg[data-current="true"]` | `background: var(--pitch)`. |
| `.wl-repeat` | A list of repeatable rows: `display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-3)`. |
| `.wl-repeat__row` | `display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: var(--space-2); align-items: end`. Player rows add `.wl-repeat__row--pair`: under 768px `grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr)` (both fields and the Remove button stack, Remove is `justify-self: end`); from 768px `grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr) auto`. |
| `.wl-terms` | The terms text block: a `wl-card` with `display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-4)`. No inner scrolling at any width; the page scrolls. Each term is an `h3.body-strong` followed by `p.body`. |
| `.wl-checklist` | The "What happens next" list on `/scout`: `display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-2)`. Each `li` is `display: flex; gap: var(--space-2); align-items: flex-start`, icon 20px. A done item's icon uses `color: var(--pitch)`; a to-do item's icon uses `color: var(--ink-muted)`. |
| `.wl-inline-status` | Icon plus words in `caption`: `display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-1)`, `svg { width: 16px; height: 16px }`. Modifiers set the colour of icon and text together: `--ok` `var(--pitch)`, `--warn` `var(--warning)`, `--muted` `var(--ink-muted)`. All three are text-safe on `surface` and `surface-raised` in both themes. |

## Surface 1: public scout registration, `/register`

**Who, where, job.** Used by an independent scout or recruiter who wants to review matches, mostly on a phone, sometimes on a laptop. A coach or agent who already has a Wideline account uses it too, signed in. One job: ask to become a Wideline reviewer, with identity, conflicts and terms in one sitting.

**Access.** Public (`register` segment in `lib/public-paths.ts`). `registerScoutAction` is on the guarded-actions allowlist.

- Signed in with a ScoutProfile: redirect to `/scout`.
- Signed in without one: name and email come from the account.
- Signed out: the same 4 steps; name and email are typed. There is no password step (see the deviation above).

### Frame and layout

- Outside the app shell, like `/apply`. `main#main.mx-auto.max-w-xl.px-4.md:px-6.py-8.md:py-12`. It is top-aligned, not vertically centred, so steps of different heights do not jump.
- Order: wordmark (`p.font-display.heading-2`, "Wideline"), eyebrow **Scout registration** (`eyebrow text-ink-muted mt-6`), h1 **Register as a scout** (`heading-1 mt-1`), intro (`body text-ink-muted mt-2`), then the progress bar (JavaScript only, `mt-6`), then the form (`mt-6`).
- Intro: **Scouts review matches on Wideline: they check the events our software finds and add any it missed. Wideline staff check every scout before they can review. It takes about 5 minutes.**
- Under the form, `caption mt-6`: **Already have an account? Sign in** ("Sign in" links to `/login?next=/register`, `text-pitch underline`). Hidden when signed in.

| | 375 | 768 | 1280 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Column | Full width with the `space-4` gutter | 36rem column (`max-w-xl`), centred | Same as 768. No side panel |
| Fields | Stacked | Stacked; player rows put name and club side by side | Same as 768 |
| Step buttons | One row: Back and Continue, each `flex-1`, 48px. Step 1 has Continue only, full width | Back left, Continue right (`justify-between`), auto width | Same as 768 |
| Terms | Full-width card, page scrolls | Same | Same |

### Structure: one `<form noValidate>`, one `fieldset` per step

Each step is `<fieldset aria-labelledby="step-N-title" class="flex flex-col gap-4">`, holding:

1. `h2#step-N-title` with `tabIndex={-1}`, holding two spans: `span.caption.block.text-ink-muted` **Step N of 4** and `span.heading-2.block` with the step title.
2. Optional step intro, `p.body.text-ink-muted`.
3. The fields.
4. The step error banner slot (see Errors).
5. The step buttons, `div.flex.gap-2.mt-2`: secondary **Back** (icon `ArrowLeft`, `type="button"`) and primary **Continue** (icon none, `type="button"`). On the last step, Continue is replaced by `SubmitButton` primary **Register as a scout**, pending label **Registering…**.

**With JavaScript** (after hydration, an `enhanced` flag): only the current step is shown; the others get the `hidden` attribute, so their values are kept. The progress bar shows N segments (`data-done` for earlier steps, `data-current` for the current one).

**Without JavaScript:** every step shows, stacked with `mt-8` between them, and Back and Continue are not rendered. The one submit button sits at the end. The progress bar is not rendered. "Step N of 4" stays as section numbering.

**Step change.**
- Continue runs the step's client checks (required, email shape, phone shape, 13 digits for a South African ID). On failure it shows the field errors, focuses the first invalid field and stays.
- On success it shows the next step, moves focus to its `h2`, and sets `document.title` to **{Step title} · Register as a scout · Wideline**.
- Back shows the previous step and focuses its `h2`. Nothing is cleared.
- Pressing Enter in a text field before the last step does what Continue does: the form's `onSubmit` checks the current step and advances instead of submitting.

### Step 1: About you

| Field | Control | Label | Hint and errors |
|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `input name="name" required maxLength={120} autoComplete="name"` | **Your name** | Hint: **As it appears on your ID or passport.** Errors: **Enter your name.** / **Use 120 characters or fewer.** |
| Email | `input type="email" name="email" required autoComplete="email"` | **Email** | Hint: **We send your confirmation link and our decision here.** Error: the shared `EMAIL_ERROR` (**Enter an email address, for example name@club.co.za.**). Existing account, signed out: **An account already uses this email. Sign in, then come back to register.** |
| Phone | `input type="tel" name="phone" required autoComplete="tel" inputMode="tel"` | **Mobile number** | Hint: **South African numbers can start with 0, for example 082 123 4567. Other numbers start with + and the country code.** Errors: **Enter your mobile number.** / **Enter a mobile number, for example 082 123 4567 or +44 7700 900123.** |

Signed in: Name and Email are `readOnly` and prefilled from the account, and are not submitted (the server uses the session user). Email hint: **Your scout profile is added to this account.** Name hint: **From your Wideline account.**

### Step 2: Your identity

Intro: **We use your ID or passport number once, to check that each person registers only once. We keep only a check value made from it, never the number itself.**

| Field | Control | Label | Hint and errors |
|---|---|---|---|
| Document type | `fieldset` with `legend.label` **Document**, holding two `label.wl-decision__choice` radio cards (`name="idDocumentType"`, values `sa_id` and `passport`, `required`, none preselected). Card 1: **South African ID**, hint **13 digits**. Card 2: **Passport**, hint **From any country** | (legend) | Error: **Choose South African ID or passport.** The fieldset gets `data-invalid="true"`. |
| Number | `input name="idNumber" required autoComplete="off" spellCheck={false}`. `inputMode="numeric"` and `maxLength={13}` for `sa_id`; `autoCapitalize="characters"` and `maxLength={24}` for passport | **ID number** (sa_id), **Passport number** (passport), **ID or passport number** (nothing chosen, and without JavaScript) | Hint, always shown, with a `LockKeyhole` icon: **We keep only a check value, never the number.** Errors below. |
| Issuing country | `select name="idCountry"`, first option **Choose a country** (value ""), then `countryOptions()` | **Country that issued your passport** | Shown only when Passport is chosen (with JavaScript). Without JavaScript it always shows, with the label **Country that issued your passport (passports only)**. Error: **Choose the country that issued your passport.** |

Number errors:

| Case | Copy |
|---|---|
| Empty | **Enter your ID number.** / **Enter your passport number.** |
| South African ID: wrong length, bad check digit or impossible date | **This ID number is not valid. Check the 13 digits.** (One message for all three; the server never says which check failed.) |
| South African ID: under 18 | **You need to be 18 or older to review matches.** |
| Passport format | **Use 6 to 20 letters and numbers, as printed in your passport.** |
| Identity already registered (`identity_taken`) | **This ID or passport is already registered. If it is yours, sign in to your existing account.** |

Changing the document type clears the number field and its error, so a South African ID never sits in a passport field.

### Step 3: Clubs and players you are linked to

Intro: **You cannot review a match involving a club you work for, or a player you represent. Tell us about them now. You can change this later on your scout profile.**

Two groups, then the "none" box:

1. `fieldset` with `legend.body-strong` **Clubs you work for or with**. A `div.wl-repeat` of club rows. Each row is `div.wl-repeat__row` with `role="group"` and `aria-label="Club {n}"`:
   - `Field` **Club name**: `input name="clubName" maxLength={120} autoComplete="off"`.
   - Ghost sm button **Remove** (icon `Trash2`, `aria-label="Remove club {n}"`, `type="button"`).
   - After the rows: ghost button **Add a club** (icon `Plus`, `type="button"`).
2. `fieldset` with `legend.body-strong` **Players you represent**. Rows are `div.wl-repeat__row.wl-repeat__row--pair` with `role="group"` and `aria-label="Player {n}"`:
   - `Field` **Player name**: `input name="playerName" maxLength={120} autoComplete="off"`.
   - `Field` **Their club (optional)**: `input name="playerClub" maxLength={120} autoComplete="off"`. Hint: **Helps us match the right player.**
   - Ghost sm **Remove** (`aria-label="Remove player {n}"`).
   - After the rows: ghost **Add a player** (icon `Plus`).
3. `label.wl-choice.wl-choice--top.body` with `input type="checkbox" name="noAffiliations" value="yes"`: **I have no clubs or players to declare.**

Rules:
- The server renders 3 empty rows per group, so the form works without JavaScript. After hydration, empty rows after the first are removed, so each group shows one row.
- At most 30 rows per group (server-enforced too). At 30, the Add button is hidden and `caption text-ink-muted` says **You can add up to 30 here. Add more later on your scout profile.**
- Blank rows are ignored. A player club without a player name is an error on the name.
- Ticking the box (with JavaScript) hides both groups and disables their inputs. Unticking shows them again with their values.
- **Add** appends a row and focuses its first input. **Remove** deletes the row and focuses the previous row's first input, or the Add button when none is left. With one row left, Remove clears it instead of deleting it.
- Field errors are keyed `clubName.{i}`, `playerName.{i}` and `playerClub.{i}`, and show under the matching input.

Errors:

| Case | Copy (where) |
|---|---|
| No rows and no tick | **Add a club or a player, or tick "I have no clubs or players to declare".** (on the checkbox) |
| Rows filled and the box ticked (no JavaScript) | **Untick this box, or remove the clubs and players you added.** (on the checkbox) |
| Club name over 120 | **Use 120 characters or fewer.** |
| Player club without a name | **Enter the player's name.** |
| Over 30 rows (tampered) | **You can add up to 30 here.** (step banner) |

### Step 4: Reviewer confidentiality terms

This step is Surface 2. It is the last step and ends with **Register as a scout**.

Submit: primary **Register as a scout**, pending **Registering…**. Signed out, under it, `caption text-ink-muted mt-2`: **We email you a link to confirm your address and sign in.**

Honeypot after the last fieldset, as in C01 (`name="website"`, `sr-only`, `aria-hidden`, `tabIndex={-1}`).

### After submit

| Result | Behaviour and copy |
|---|---|
| Success, new account | Nothing signs in. The action sends the confirmation email (its link signs in and lands on `/scout?registered=1`) and replaces the form with h1 **Check your email** (`heading-1`, `tabIndex={-1}`, focused), `body-lg text-ink-muted mt-2` **We sent a link to {email}. Open it to confirm your email and sign in to your scout profile. The link works for 24 hours.**, then `body text-ink-muted mt-4` **No email after a few minutes? Check your spam folder, or sign in with Email me a sign-in link.** ("sign in" links to `/login?next=/scout`). |
| Success, signed in | Sets the active organisation to the scout network and redirects to `/scout?registered=1`. |
| Field errors | The form shows the step that holds the first error (step order, then DOM order), focuses that field, and shows a `wl-banner--danger` (`role="alert"`) at the top of that step: **Some details need fixing. Check the highlighted fields.** Other steps with errors show their errors when reached. Values stay in the form (useFormAction). The ID number is never in the result. |
| `account_exists` | Field error on Email (step 1, copy above). |
| `identity_taken` | Field error on the number (step 2, copy above). |
| `already_registered` (race) | Redirect to `/scout`. |
| Honeypot filled | Signed out: the same **Check your email** result as a real registration. Signed in: replace the form with h1 **Registration received** (`heading-1`, `tabIndex={-1}`, focused) and `body-lg text-ink-muted mt-2`: **We will email you about your registration.** Nothing is created. |
| Unexpected error | `wl-banner--danger` above the submit button: **Something went wrong. Try again.** |
| Without JavaScript, any error | The page re-renders with every step stacked and the errors in place. Fields are empty again, as on `/apply`; the ID number is never echoed. |

### States

| State | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| Loading | No `loading.tsx`. Pending label and `aria-busy` on the form only. |
| Forbidden | None; the page is public. |
| Long content | Names wrap. The terms step is long on a phone; the page scrolls and the checkbox and buttons follow the text. |
| Many rows | Up to 30 per group; the page grows. |

### Keyboard and screen readers

- `document.title`: **Register as a scout · Wideline**, then per step as above.
- Tab order per step: the fields in DOM order, the Add and Remove buttons in their group, the checkbox, Back, Continue. Radio cards move with the arrow keys; the focus ring draws around the whole card (`:has(input:focus-visible)`).
- Each step `h2` reads "Step 2 of 4, Your identity" when focused.
- Each row's `role="group"` with `aria-label` ("Club 2") disambiguates the repeated **Club name** labels.
- The number input keeps `autoComplete="off"` so the browser does not save it.
- No shortcuts.

## Surface 2: terms acceptance (step 4 of `/register`, and the terms section on `/scout`)

**Who, where, job.** The scout, on a phone or laptop. One job: read the reviewer confidentiality terms and accept them, on registration and again whenever the version changes.

**Component.** `web/src/app/register/TermsText.tsx`, a server-safe component that renders `REVIEWER_TERMS` from `src/server/scouts/terms.ts` (each section `{ heading, body }`) inside `div.wl-terms.wl-card`. Both `/register` and `/scout` use it. The text lives in one place.

### Structure

1. Step title (on `/register`): **Confidentiality terms**. Intro: **Match footage shows players, many of them children. These terms protect them. Read them before you accept.**
2. The terms card. Each section is `h3.body-strong` and `p.body`. Under the last section, `caption text-ink-muted`: **Version {REVIEWER_TERMS_VERSION}**.
3. `label.wl-choice.wl-choice--top.body` with `input type="checkbox" name="acceptTerms" value="yes" required`: **I am 18 or older, and I accept the reviewer confidentiality terms.**
   - Error: **Tick this box to continue. You need to accept the terms to review matches.**

### Terms text (draft for legal review, Q-004)

| Heading | Body |
|---|---|
| **Keep footage confidential** | Watch match footage only inside Wideline, and only to review the match you claimed. Do not describe or share what you see with anyone outside Wideline. |
| **Do not download or record** | Do not download, screen-record, photograph or copy any footage, clip or stat. Every review session is logged. |
| **Do not contact players or clubs** | Do not contact a player, their family or their club about anything you saw while reviewing, unless you do it through Wideline. |
| **Declare your conflicts** | Tell us about every club you work for or with, and every player you represent. Keep the list up to date on your scout profile. You cannot review matches involving them. |
| **Who can review** | You must be 18 or older. Your account is for you alone; do not let anyone else use it. |
| **If you break these terms** | We can suspend your review access straight away and remove you from Wideline. |

### On `/scout`

See Surface 3, "Terms section". The checkbox there reads **I accept the updated reviewer confidentiality terms.** (Age was confirmed at registration.)

### Layout, states, keyboard

- Same column at every width. No inner scroll box: a scroll box is hard to read on a phone and hides text from keyboard users.
- The checkbox is a native control, 20px with a 44px tall row under 768px (`.wl-choice`).
- Tab order: the checkbox, then the step buttons. The terms text has no focusable content.

## Surface 3: the scout's own profile, `/scout`

**Who, where, job.** Used by a scout, mostly on a phone. One job: see where their registration stands and what to do next, and keep their phone number, conflicts and terms up to date.

**Access.** `requirePageRole(SCOUT_ROLES)`. Every action in `actions.ts` calls `requireRole(SCOUT_ROLES)` and touches only `ctx.user.id`'s profile. Other roles go to `/forbidden`.

### Structure (DOM order = visual order = tab order)

Page wrapper: `div.max-w-3xl` inside the shell's `main`. Single column at every width; the forms read better narrow.

1. `PageHeader`: title **Scout profile**, intro **Your registration, the clubs and players you are linked to, and the terms you accepted.**
2. Page banner slot (`aria-live="polite"`, `mt-6 empty:mt-0`):
   - `?registered=1`: `wl-banner--ok`: **Registration received. A Wideline admin checks your details. We email you when it is decided.** (Email not confirmed, for a signed-in registration: **Registration received. Confirm your email, then a Wideline admin checks your details. We email you when it is decided.**)
   - `?from=review` (set by `requireReviewerPage`): `wl-banner` (warning, `Clock`): **The review queue opens once your scout profile is approved and you have accepted the current terms.**
3. **Status panel** (`StatusPanel.tsx`): `section.wl-card.mt-6` with `aria-labelledby` its `h2`.
3a. **Set a password** (`PasswordSection.tsx`), only while the account has no password and the email is confirmed: `section.mt-8`, `h2.heading-2` **Set a password**, `body text-ink-muted mt-2` **You can always sign in with a link we email you. Set a password to sign in with your email and password instead.**, then a `wl-inline-form`: a hidden `autoComplete="username"` email for password managers, `Field` **Password** (`type="password" autoComplete="new-password"`, hint **At least 12 characters.**, error **Use at least 12 characters.**), secondary `SubmitButton` **Set password** (pending **Saving…**). Saved: the form goes, `wl-banner--ok` **Password set. You can now sign in with your email and this password.**, focus on the `h2`; the section is gone on the next load. It never replaces a password.
4. **Details** (`DetailsSection.tsx`): `section.mt-8`, `h2.heading-2` **Your details**.
5. **Conflicts** (`AffiliationsSection.tsx`): `section.mt-8`, `h2.heading-2` **Clubs and players you are linked to**.
6. **Terms** (`TermsSection.tsx`): `section#terms.mt-8`, `h2.heading-2` **Confidentiality terms**.

Every section `h2` has `tabIndex={-1}` and is the focus target after that section's action.

### Status panel

Layout: row 1 is the `ScoutStatusChip`; row 2 is the `h2.heading-2` (the status title); then the body (`body text-ink-muted mt-2`), then status content at `mt-4`. At 375 everything stacks; from 768 the action button sits at the right of the title row (`flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4`).

| Status | Chip | h2 | Body | Content |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| pending | Awaiting approval | **We are checking your registration** | **A Wideline admin checks every scout before they can review matches. We email {email} when it is decided.** | `h3.label` **What happens next**, then `ol.wl-checklist`: (1) **Confirm your email** (done when `emailVerified`), (2) **A Wideline admin checks your details**, (3) **You can review matches**. Done items use `CircleCheck` plus `span.sr-only` "Done:"; to-do items use `Circle` plus `span.sr-only` "To do:". |
| approved, current terms | Approved | **You can review matches** | **Approved on {verifiedAt date}.** | Primary `ButtonLink` **Go to the review queue** to `/review` (block under 768px). |
| approved, stale terms | Approved | **Accept the new terms to keep reviewing** | **We updated the reviewer confidentiality terms. Read them and accept them to review matches again.** | Secondary `ButtonLink` **Read the new terms** to `#terms`. (The primary button of the page is Accept in the terms section.) |
| rejected | Not approved | **Your registration was not approved** | **Decided on {reviewedAt date}.** | When a reason exists: `p.body` **Reason: {reason}**. Then `p.body text-ink-muted mt-2`: **If you have questions, reply to the email we sent you.** |
| suspended | Suspended | **Your review access is suspended** | **Suspended on {suspendedAt date}. You cannot claim or review matches. Your details and conflicts stay as they are.** | `p.body` **Reason: {suspensionReason}**. Then **If you have questions, reply to the email we sent you.** |

**Email not confirmed** (any status except rejected): under the status content, a `wl-banner` (warning, `MailWarning` icon), then a form:
- Banner text: **Confirm your email. We sent a link to {email}. We cannot approve your registration until you confirm it.** For an approved scout (rare, for example an admin-created account): **Confirm your email. We sent a link to {email}.**
- Under it, secondary sm `SubmitButton` **Resend email** (icon `RotateCw`, pending **Sending…**), `mt-3`.
- Sent: the banner is replaced by `wl-banner--ok`: **We sent a new link to {email}. It can take a few minutes to arrive.**
- Failed or throttled: `wl-banner--danger`: **We could not send the email. Try again in a few minutes.**

### Details section

A `dl` in a `wl-card`: `grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-[auto_1fr] gap-x-6 gap-y-3`. Terms (`dt`) in `label text-ink-muted`; values (`dd`) in `body`. At 375 each `dt` sits above its `dd`.

| Term | Value |
|---|---|
| **Name** | The user's name, `body-strong`. |
| **Email** | The email (`break-all`), then on a new line `.wl-inline-status--ok` with `MailCheck` **Confirmed**, or `.wl-inline-status--warn` with `MailWarning` **Not confirmed**. |
| **Identity document** | **South African ID** or **Passport · issued by {country name}**. Under it, `.wl-inline-status--muted` with `LockKeyhole`: **Number stored as a check value only.** |
| **Registered** | `createdAt` date in `data`. |

Under the card, `caption text-ink-muted mt-2`: **Your name and identity document cannot be changed here.**

Then the phone form, `form.mt-6.flex.flex-col.gap-3.md:flex-row.md:items-end`:
- `Field` **Mobile number** (`type="tel" name="phone" autoComplete="tel" inputMode="tel"`, prefilled with the stored number, `md:flex-1`). Same hint and errors as registration step 1.
- Secondary `SubmitButton` **Save number** (pending **Saving…**), block under 768px.
- Saved: `wl-banner--ok` at the top of the section: **Mobile number saved.** Unchanged: the same banner, and no audit row.

### Conflicts section (`AffiliationsSection.tsx`)

Intro (`body text-ink-muted mt-2 max-w-prose`): **You cannot review a match involving a club on this list, or the club of a player you represent. Wideline staff match each name to a club on Wideline. A name blocks matches only once it is matched, so check the spelling.**

Then two sub-sections, each `h3.body-strong mt-6`:

**Clubs** (`h3` **Clubs**):
- `ul role="list"` inside a `wl-card p-0`, rows divided by `line` (`divide-y divide-line`), each `li` padded `p-4` (`space-4`), `flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3`:
  - Left: club name in `body-strong` (`break-words`), then the match state on a new line: `.wl-inline-status--ok` `Link2` **Matched on Wideline**, or `.wl-inline-status--muted` `CircleDashed` **Not matched yet**. Then `caption text-ink-muted`: **Added {declaredAt date}**.
  - Right: danger sm **Remove** (icon `Trash2`, `aria-label="Remove {name}"`), opening a ConfirmDialog.
- Add form below the list, `mt-3`: `form.flex.flex-col.gap-3.md:flex-row.md:items-end`: `Field` **Club name** (`name="name"`, `maxLength={120}`, hidden `type=club`), secondary `SubmitButton` **Add club** (icon `Plus`, pending **Adding…**).

**Players you represent** (`h3`):
- Same list. Left: player name in `body-strong`, then `caption text-ink-muted` with their club (**{clubName}**, or **Club not given**), then the match state, then **Added {date}**.
- Add form: `Field` **Player name**, `Field` **Their club (optional)** (hint **Helps us match the right player.**), secondary **Add player** (icon `Plus`, pending **Adding…**). At 375 stacked; from 768 the two fields and the button sit in one row.

Remove dialog:
- Title: **Remove {name}?**
- Body: **You will be able to review matches involving {name} again. Wideline keeps a record that you removed it.**
- Buttons: danger **Remove** (pending **Removing…**) and secondary **Cancel**.

| State | Copy |
|---|---|
| Added | `wl-banner--ok` at the top of the section: **Added {name}.** The form resets; focus returns to its first field. |
| Removed | **Removed {name}.** Focus moves to the section `h2`. |
| Empty clubs | In place of the list, `body text-ink-muted`: **No clubs on your list.** |
| Empty players | **No players on your list.** |
| Both empty | Under the intro, `caption text-ink-muted`: **You told us you have no conflicts. Add any club you start working with, or player you start representing.** |
| Name empty | **Enter the club name.** / **Enter the player's name.** |
| Too long | **Use 120 characters or fewer.** |
| Same name already on the list (case-insensitive, active rows) | **{name} is already on your list.** |
| Over 30 of one type | **You can have up to 30 clubs on your list. Remove one first.** (or **players**) |
| Already removed (race) | `wl-banner--danger`: **That entry was already removed.** The list re-renders. |
| Long content | Names wrap; the Remove button never shrinks (`shrink-0`). |
| Many rows | No pagination; up to 30 per type. |

Removed affiliations are not shown to the scout.

### Terms section (`TermsSection.tsx`)

| Case | Content |
|---|---|
| Current version accepted | `p.body`: **You accepted version {termsVersion} on {termsAcceptedAt date}.** Then a native `details` (`mt-3`) with `summary.wl-btn.wl-btn--ghost.wl-btn--sm` **Read the terms**; open, it shows `TermsText`. |
| Stale version | `wl-banner` (warning, `TriangleAlert`): **The terms have changed. Accept the new version to review matches again.** Then `p.caption text-ink-muted mt-3`: **You accepted version {termsVersion} on {date}.** Then `TermsText` (open, `mt-4`), then a form: the checkbox **I accept the updated reviewer confidentiality terms.** (`required`) and primary `SubmitButton` **Accept the terms** (pending **Saving…**, block under 768px). |
| Accepted | `wl-banner--ok`: **Terms accepted. You can review matches again.** For a scout who is not approved: **Terms accepted.** The section re-renders in the "current" case; the status panel updates. |
| Box not ticked | **Tick this box to accept the terms.** |
| Version changed again while open (race) | `wl-banner--danger`: **The terms changed while you were reading. Read the new version below.** |

### Page states

| State | Behaviour and copy |
|---|---|
| Scout role, no ScoutProfile (a club-invited scout) | `PageHeader` as above, then `EmptyState` (with art): title **No scout profile yet**, body **To review matches on Wideline, register as a scout. Your club membership stays as it is.**, action primary `ButtonLink` **Register as a scout** to `/register`. |
| Not a scout | `/forbidden`. Signed out: `/login?next=/scout`. |
| Loading | The inherited `(app)/loading.tsx` (`ListSkeleton`). No new loading file. Pending labels on every form. |
| Error | The inherited `(app)/error.tsx`. Action failures: **Something went wrong. Try again.** in the section's danger banner. |
| Partial data | No reason on a rejection: leave the Reason line out. No `verifiedAt` on an approved profile: **Approved.** without a date. A player with no club: **Club not given**. |
| Long content | Long emails `break-all`; names and reasons wrap. |

### Keyboard and screen readers

- Tab order: page banner (no focusable content), status panel action (Go to the review queue, Read the new terms, or Resend email), phone field, Save number, each club's Remove, Club name, Add club, each player's Remove, Player name, Their club, Add player, Read the terms (or the checkbox and Accept the terms).
- Each section is a landmark named by its `h2`. Section banners sit in always-rendered `aria-live="polite"` containers (C01 pattern).
- The chip text is read as plain text ("Awaiting approval"); its icon is `aria-hidden`.
- The checklist reads "Done: Confirm your email", "To do: A Wideline admin checks your details".
- No shortcuts.

## Surface 4: admin scout-approval list, `/admin/scouts`

**Who, where, job.** Used by Wideline staff (`platform_admin`), on a desktop, now and then on a phone. One job: approve real, conflict-declared scouts quickly, turn down the rest with a reason, and suspend a scout who breaks the terms.

**Access.** `requirePageRole(PLATFORM_ROLES)`. Every action calls `requireRole(PLATFORM_ROLES)`, then `revalidatePath("/admin/scouts")`.

### Structure

1. `PageHeader`: title **Scout registrations**, intro **Independent scouts who asked to review matches. Approving a scout opens the review queue to them. Wideline never stores ID or passport numbers, so they are not shown here.**
2. `AdminNav` (Surface 5), current **Scouts**.
3. `<nav aria-label="Registration status" class="wl-tabs mt-6">`:
   - **Pending** plus the count in `data` (`?status=pending`, the default)
   - **Approved** (`?status=approved`)
   - **Suspended** (`?status=suspended`)
   - **Not approved** (`?status=rejected`)
   An unknown `status` value falls back to Pending.
3a. Pending, Approved and Suspended, when any scout in the tab has an unchecked club or player, or the filter is on: `p.body.mt-4` with `.wl-inline-status--warn` `CircleDashed` **{n} scouts here have clubs or players nobody has checked.** (**1 scout here has a club or player nobody has checked.**), then a `text-pitch underline` link **Show only these** (`?status={tab}&unchecked=1`) or **Show all scouts**. Filtered and empty: **Every club and player here has been checked.**
4. `section` with an `sr-only` `h2` **Scouts** (`tabIndex={-1}`, the focus target), the banner slot (`aria-live="polite"`), then the table (from 768px) or the card list (under 768px). Component: `ScoutApplications.tsx`.

### Table columns per tab

DataTable-style markup as in C01's Applications: `div.wl-card.p-0.wl-table-wrap.hidden.md:block` with `role="region"`, `aria-label` = caption, `tabIndex={0}`; `table.wl-table`; `caption.sr-only`.

| Tab | Caption | Columns |
|---|---|---|
| Pending | **Pending scout registrations, oldest first** | Scout, Identity, Registered, Conflicts, Actions |
| Approved | **Approved scouts, newest first** | Scout, Identity, Approved, Conflicts, Actions |
| Suspended | **Suspended scouts, newest first** | Scout, Identity, Suspended, Conflicts, Actions |
| Not approved | **Registrations not approved, newest first** | Scout, Identity, Decided, Reason |

Cells:

| Column | Content |
|---|---|
| Scout | Name in `body-strong`. Email in `caption text-ink-muted break-all`. Email state on its own line: `.wl-inline-status--ok` `MailCheck` **Email confirmed** or `.wl-inline-status--warn` `MailWarning` **Email not confirmed**. Phone in `data` on the next line. |
| Identity | **South African ID** or **Passport · {country name}**, `body`. |
| Registered / Approved / Suspended / Decided | The date in `data` (`createdAt`, `verifiedAt`, `suspendedAt`, `reviewedAt`). Under it, `caption text-ink-muted`: **Terms {termsVersion}**. When the version is not current: `.wl-inline-status--warn` `TriangleAlert` **Not on current terms**. In Suspended, the reason follows in `body` (**Reason: {reason}**). |
| Conflicts | See below. |
| Reason | The rejection reason in `body`, or "–" in `text-ink-muted`. |
| Actions | Right-aligned `wl-row`, see below. |

**Conflicts cell.** "–" in `text-ink-muted` when the scout declared none, with `caption text-ink-muted` **Declared no conflicts**. Otherwise a `ul.flex.flex-col.gap-3`, one `li` per active affiliation:
- `body-strong` name; `caption text-ink-muted` **Club**, or **Player · {clubName}** (**Player · club not given**).
- Match state: `.wl-inline-status--ok` `Link2` **Matched to {org name}**; `.wl-inline-status--muted` `Check` **Checked: not matched** (an admin saved Not matched); or `.wl-inline-status--warn` `CircleDashed` **Not checked yet**.
- When unmatched and an active organisation has the same name: `caption text-ink-muted` **Same name as {org name}, so it counts as a conflict with it.**
- An inline `form.mt-1.flex.flex-col.items-start.gap-2.xl:flex-row.xl:items-end` (stacked below 1280px). The select's label has `.wl-link-select`, which keeps `min-width: calc(var(--space-12) * 3)` inside `.wl-table`, so a narrow column makes the region scroll sideways instead of crushing the select:
  - `select.wl-input` with an `sr-only` label **Wideline organisation for {name}**. Options: **Not matched** (value ""), then every active academy, club and agency as **{name} · {type label}**, sorted by name. Preselected: the linked organisation, else (unchecked rows) the same-named organisation, else Not matched.
  - Secondary sm `SubmitButton` **Save match** (`aria-label="Save match for {name}"`, pending **Saving…**).
- Every affiliation is listed; the row grows. No truncation.

**Actions per tab:**

| Tab | Actions |
|---|---|
| Pending | **Approve**: secondary sm, icon `Check`, `aria-label="Approve {name}"`, pending **Approving…**, submits directly (as C01). When the email is not confirmed, the button is `disabled` and a `caption text-ink-muted` line under the actions says **Approve once their email is confirmed.** (the button's `aria-describedby` points at it). Then **Reject**: danger sm, icon `X`, `aria-label="Reject {name}"`, opens a dialog. |
| Approved | **Suspend**: danger sm, icon `Ban`, `aria-label="Suspend {name}"`, opens a dialog. |
| Suspended | **Reinstate**: secondary sm, icon `RotateCcw`, `aria-label="Reinstate {name}"`, opens a dialog. |
| Not approved | None. |

### Dialogs (ConfirmDialog)

| Dialog | Title | Body | Field | Buttons (pending label) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Reject | **Reject {name}?** | **We email {name} at {email} to say their registration was not approved. They cannot register again with the same ID or passport.** | `textarea name="reason" maxLength={500}`, label **Reason (optional)**, hint **Included in the email. Keep it short and factual.** | Danger **Reject registration** (**Rejecting…**), secondary **Cancel** |
| Suspend | **Suspend {name}?** | **{name} loses access to the review queue on their next page load. We email them the reason.** | `textarea name="reason" required maxLength={500}`, label **Reason**, hint **Included in the email. Keep it short and factual.** Error: **Enter a reason for the suspension.** | Danger **Suspend scout** (**Suspending…**), secondary **Cancel** |
| Reinstate | **Reinstate {name}?** | **{name} can review matches again once they have accepted the current terms. We email them to say so.** | none | Primary **Reinstate scout** (**Reinstating…**), secondary **Cancel** |

Focus follows the C01 ConfirmDialog rules: the first field, or Cancel when there is none.

### Layout

| | 375 | 768 | 1280 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Nav bars | Both `wl-tabs` full width; the status bar scrolls sideways if needed | Inline | Inline |
| Rows | Cards (below) | Table in its scroll region; long cells wrap, and the region scrolls sideways when the rail narrows it | Table, all columns visible at the 1280 content width |

**Card (under 768px).** `ul role="list" class="mt-6 flex flex-col gap-3 md:hidden"`, one `li.wl-card.flex.flex-col.gap-2`:
1. Name (`body-strong`) and, outside Pending, the `ScoutStatusChip`, spaced between.
2. Email (`caption break-all`), email state, phone (`data`).
3. Identity, then "{date label} {date}" (**Registered 23 Oct 2026**, **Approved …**, **Suspended …**, **Decided …**) and the terms line, in `caption text-ink-muted`.
4. Reason (Suspended, Not approved), `body`.
5. `h3.label` **Conflicts**, then the same conflict list; the select and Save match stack, both full width.
6. Actions: a `flex gap-2 [&>*]:flex-1` row (Approve and Reject; or Suspend; or Reinstate), 44px tall. The disabled-approve note sits under the row.

No `id` attributes inside the duplicated rows (C01 rule).

### States and copy

| State | Behaviour and copy |
|---|---|
| Approved | `wl-banner--ok`: **Approved {name}. We emailed them a link to the review queue.** The row leaves Pending. |
| Approved, email failed | `wl-banner` (warning): **Approved {name}, but the email to {email} did not send. They can still sign in and review matches.** |
| Rejected | **Rejected {name}. We emailed {email}.** Failed email: **Rejected {name}, but the email to {email} did not send.** |
| Suspended | **Suspended {name}. We emailed {email} the reason.** Failed email: **Suspended {name}, but the email to {email} did not send.** |
| Reinstated | **Reinstated {name}. We emailed {email}.** Failed email: **Reinstated {name}, but the email to {email} did not send.** |
| Match saved | **Matched {affiliation} to {org name}.** Not matched: **{affiliation} is checked and not matched to a Wideline organisation.** The row stays; focus stays on the Save match button. |
| Already decided (`not_pending`, another admin) | `wl-banner--danger`, `role="alert"`: **{name} has already been decided. The list is up to date now.** |
| Illegal transition (stale tab) | **{name} is no longer approved, so they cannot be suspended.** / **{name} is no longer suspended.** The list re-renders. |
| `email_unconfirmed` (tampered or race) | **{name} has not confirmed their email yet, so you cannot approve them.** |
| Affiliation removed meanwhile | **{name} removed this conflict, so it cannot be matched.** |
| Organisation no longer active | **That organisation is no longer active. Choose another.** |
| Reason too long | Dialog error: **Use 500 characters or fewer.** |
| Unexpected | **Something went wrong. Try again.** |
| Empty Pending | `body-lg text-ink-muted mt-6`: **No registrations waiting. New scouts appear here when they register.** |
| Empty Approved | **No approved scouts yet.** |
| Empty Suspended | **No suspended scouts.** |
| Empty Not approved | **No registrations turned down.** |
| Small sample | One row; nothing extra. |
| Long content | Names, reasons and affiliation names wrap; emails `break-all`; the table scrolls inside its region. |
| Many rows | No pagination in v0 (pilot target is 10 reviewers). |
| Loading | Inherited `ListSkeleton`; pending labels on every button. |
| Forbidden | Every non-platform role goes to `/forbidden`. |

### Keyboard and screen readers

- Tab order: AdminNav links, the four status tabs, the table region (focusable so it can scroll), then per row: each affiliation's select and Save match, then the row actions.
- After Approve, Reject, Suspend or Reinstate, focus moves to the `sr-only` `h2` **Scouts** and the banner is announced.
- Every icon is `aria-hidden`; each state has its word.
- No shortcuts.

## Surface 5: `AdminNav`, `web/src/app/(app)/admin/AdminNav.tsx`

**Who, where, job.** Wideline staff, any device. One job: move between the two admin lists.

- Same pattern as `settings/SettingsNav.tsx`: `<nav aria-label="Admin" class="wl-tabs mt-6">` with `Link class="body-strong"` items **Organisations** (`/admin/organisations`) and **Scouts** (`/admin/scouts`). Prop `current: "organisations" | "scouts"` sets `aria-current="page"`.
- Rendered right after `PageHeader` on both admin pages. Each page's status bar follows it at `mt-6`, so the order is: header, section nav, status filter, content.
- At 375 both bars are full width; links are 44px tall (existing `.wl-tabs` rule).
- The main nav's **Admin** item still opens `/admin/organisations` and is current on every `/admin/*` path.

## Surface 6: nav item and the `SCOUT_STATES` preset

**Nav item** in `lib/nav.ts`, after Shortlists:

| id | Label | href | Current when | Icon | Roles |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| scout | Scout profile | `/scout` | `/scout` | `BadgeCheck` | scout |

Add `BadgeCheck` to `NavIcon` and to the icon map in `components/shell/NavLinks.tsx`. A scout's tab bar holds 3 items (Review queue, Shortlists, Scout profile), so there is no More button. An owner who also scouts has 7 items and gets More, as D02 specifies.

**Org switcher.** The scout network shows as **Wideline scouts**, meta **Scout network**. No other switcher change.

**Chip preset** in `components/ui/StatusChip.tsx`, keyed by the Prisma `ScoutStatus` enum, with a `ScoutStatusChip` export in `index.ts`:

| State | Tone | Icon | Copy |
|---|---|---|---|
| pending | warn | `Clock` | Awaiting approval |
| approved | ok | `Check` | Approved |
| suspended | danger | `Ban` | Suspended |
| rejected | danger | `X` | Not approved |

**Gallery.** Add an eyebrow **Scout states** group to the StatusChip block in both bands, with fixtures in `fixtures.ts`. This changes the gallery screenshot baselines; regenerate with `make test-e2e-update` and say so in the STATUS log.

## Surface 7: scout emails (plain text, draft copy)

Every email starts **Hello {name},** and ends **The Wideline team**. No exclamation marks, no emoji. URLs are absolute, from the app base URL.

| Email | Subject | Body |
|---|---|---|
| Confirm email (Better Auth `sendVerificationEmail`) | **Confirm your email for Wideline** | **Confirm this email address for your Wideline account: {url}** / **We cannot approve a scout registration until the email is confirmed.** / **If you did not register on Wideline, you can ignore this email.** |
| Registration received | **We have your scout registration** | **Thanks for registering as a scout on Wideline. A Wideline admin checks every scout before they can review matches. We email you when your registration is decided.** / **If you have not confirmed your email yet, use the link in our other email.** / **See where your registration stands: {base}/scout** |
| Approved | **You can now review matches on Wideline** | **We approved your scout registration. Open the review queue to claim your first match: {base}/review** / **Remember the terms you accepted: watch footage only inside Wideline, never download or record it, and do not contact players or clubs about what you see.** |
| Rejected | **Your Wideline scout registration** | **We could not approve your scout registration.** / **Reason: {reason}** (only when given) / **If you have questions, reply to this email.** |
| Suspended | **Your Wideline review access is suspended** | **We suspended your review access on Wideline, so you cannot claim or review matches.** / **Reason: {reason}** / **If you have questions, reply to this email.** |
| Reinstated | **Your Wideline review access is back** | **We reinstated your review access. Open the review queue: {base}/review** / When the scout's terms are stale: **First accept the current confidentiality terms on your scout profile: {base}/scout** |

The "reply to this email" lines carry the C01 open item: `MAIL_FROM` is a no-reply address until C16 adds a Reply-To.

## Accessibility checks for the builder

- Run axe (wcag2a/aa, 21aa, 22aa) with zero violations at 375, 768 and 1280 on: `/register` at each step (with JavaScript), `/register` with JavaScript off (all steps stacked, at 375 only), `/scout` in pending (email unconfirmed) and approved states, and `/admin/scouts` on Pending with at least one row and an open Reject dialog.
- Keyboard path at 1280: complete registration with Tab, arrow keys, Space and Enter only; Enter in a step-1 field advances, never submits.
- Focus checks: after Continue and Back, focus is on the step `h2`; after a server field error, focus is on the first invalid field in the step that is now shown.
- Never colour alone: every chip, inline status and progress segment has a word beside it or is `aria-hidden` with the text elsewhere.
- Touch: every control is at least 44px tall under 768px, including Remove, Add a club and the radio cards.
